card.name: Step size in infusion rate increases
card.fires_on: The first digit or space of a number giving the step size when an infusion rate is raised, such as after "increments of" or "increased by". It also fires on a digit or decimal point inside a dose number.

modes.label: Step size amount
modes.description: The number right after "increments of" or "increased by" in infusion titration instructions.
modes.example: increased in increments of <<2>> ng/kg/min every 15 minutes

modes.label: Space or point before amount
modes.description: A space or decimal point just before the step amount in a rate or dose.
